tools.name: browser_agent
tools.description: Run a task on a real website with a real browser: it searches, clicks, filters, reads the page and answers. Charges 0.05 XNO per run via x402. Returns a job id at once; poll jobs via the returned links.status (free) until done.

task.description: What the agent should do, in plain language (8-500 characters).
task.title: Task

website.description: The website to do it on, e.g. arxiv.org or https://www.allrecipes.com
website.title: Website

tools.name: browser_agent_batch
tools.description: Start up to 100 browser-agent runs at once, in parallel on isolated browser contexts. Charges 0.05 XNO per run via x402 (price scales with the number of runs). Returns every job id immediately; poll each via its links.status (free).

tools.name: check_link
tools.description: Check HTTP status, response time and redirect chain for any URL. Charges 0.0001 XNO in Nano via x402.

url.description: Full http(s) URL whose HTTP status, response time and redirect chain to check.
url.title: Url

tools.name: check_url_status
tools.description: One-call URL status check: final HTTP status, redirect chain, TLS validity and days-to-expiry, response time, and whether the body changed since a previous call (pass previous_hash). Charges 0.0001 XNO in Nano via x402.

url.description: Full http(s) URL whose status, redirect chain, TLS validity and content to check.
url.title: Url

previous_hash.description: Optional hash of the body from a previous call, used to detect content drift.
previous_hash.title: Previous Hash

tools.name: domain_info
tools.description: Full domain intelligence: DNS records, WHOIS registration, SSL/TLS certificate, HTTP headers. Charges 0.0005 XNO in Nano via x402.

domain.description: Domain name (e.g. example.com) to look up DNS, WHOIS, SSL/TLS and headers for.
domain.title: Domain

tools.name: extract_url
tools.description: Extract clean text and markdown from a web page URL. Charges 0.0001 XNO in Nano via x402 protocol.

url.description: Full http(s) URL of the web page to extract clean text/markdown from.
url.title: Url

tools.name: geoip_lookup
tools.description: IP geolocation lookup: country, city, coordinates, ISP, ASN, timezone. Use 'myip' for the caller's own IP. Charges 0.0001 XNO in Nano via x402.

ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address to geolocate, or the literal 'myip' to use the caller's own IP.
ip.title: Ip

tools.name: mcp_find
tools.description: Search paid MCP and x402 service directories for a task. Returns matching services with their settlement rails, prices, and x402 health. Optional filter_rail='nano' shows only XNO-settling services. Charges 0.0001 XNO in Nano via x402.

q.description: Natural-language query — what the MCP or x402 service should do.
q.title: Q

filter_rail.description: Optional rail filter — pass 'nano' to show only services that settle in Nano (XNO), 'base' for USDC on Base, etc.
filter_rail.title: Filter Rail

tools.name: nano_account_info
tools.description: Nano account intelligence: balance, representative, block count, frontier, weight, pending transactions. Charges 0.0005 XNO in Nano via x402.

account.description: Nano account address (nano_... or xrb_...) to look up balance, representative, block count, frontier, weight, pending.
account.title: Account

tools.name: scrape_page
tools.description: Scrape one page with a real stealth browser — no AI. Returns the final URL, title, visible text, structured item cards (products, prices, listings) and interactive elements. Charges 0.002 XNO via x402. Fast (~1s).

url.description: The page to scrape, e.g. https://arxiv.org or example.com.
url.title: Url

elements.description: Include the interactive-element list (ids, roles, names).
elements.title: Elements

tools.name: scrape_pages
tools.description: Scrape up to 100 pages in parallel with real stealth browsers — no AI. Returns one result per URL: final URL, title, visible text, structured item cards and interactive elements. Charges 0.002 XNO per page via x402 (price scales with the number of pages).

urls.description: JSON list of 1-100 pages to scrape: ["https://a.com", "https://b.com"]
urls.title: Urls

elements.description: Include the interactive-element list per page.
elements.title: Elements

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Web search via DuckDuckGo. Returns structured results with titles, URLs, and snippets. Charges 0.0001 XNO in Nano via x402.

q.description: Search query string to run through the web search backend.
q.title: Q

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Extract captions and transcript from a YouTube video URL. Returns timestamped segments and model-sized chunks with deep-linked citations. Charges 0.0005 XNO in Nano via x402.

url.description: YouTube video URL (watch, youtu.be, embed or shorts format).
url.title: Url
